title: Bubble Sorceress in Cosmos
description: A woman with long dark hair floats inside a giant iridescent soap bubble in outer space. She wears a flowing purple and pink cosmic gown, reaching upward with one hand while smaller bubbles and colorful dripping liquid effects surround her against a starry nebula background.
prompt: A beautiful woman with flowing dark hair wearing a sparkling purple and pink cosmic dress floats gracefully inside a large transparent iridescent bubble in deep space. Her arm is raised reaching toward the light. The bubble has colorful pink, cyan and green dripping liquid effects cascading down its surface. Smaller bubbles float around her. The background is a vibrant starry nebula with glowing galaxies and cosmic dust in deep purple and blue tones, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed fantasy digital art.
